title: Figma tokens linked to the browser tokens: the colours that agree become one definition

chat.text: First slice of the token link you asked for: the Figma colours that already match the browser tokens by name become aliases of the styles tokens instead of second values, generated by the script and checked; the Figma tokens page shows each pair with a swatch and flags the ones that still disagree; the direction (browser tokens are the source of truth, Figma mirrors them) is decided once and written down.
